title: Student Account Activation & Unclaimed Roster Ergonomics (v0.4.21)
message: Overhauled teacher roster management with clear passwords, show/hide eye toggle, 1-tap copy, and native Android roster sharing. Resolved student account activation spinner lockup and normalized login handles.
changelog:
• Unclaimed Accounts Ergonomics: Unmasked clear passwords by default with an interactive eye toggle to mask/unmask on demand.
• 1-Tap Credential Copy & Native Sharing: Added a 1-tap copy button for individual credentials and a native Android Share Sheet button to dispatch the entire section roster to messaging apps.
• Student Claiming Stability: Fixed an issue where claiming an account could get stuck on the loading spinner by adding resilient error handling and null UID fallbacks.
• Login Normalization: Automatically strip leading @ symbols and normalize case on student login to ensure seamless credential matching.
• Teacher Registration UI: Streamlined the teacher sign-up email hint to 'Email Address' for improved clarity.
